title: Будущее в прошлом: was going to, was about to, would

why: Когда мы рассказываем о прошлом, часто нужно сказать, что было дальше с точки зрения того момента: «Я собирался позвонить», «Он знал, что всё получится». Это будущее в прошлом. В русском оно выражается обычным прошедшим временем, а в английском нужны специальные формы.
formation: • was/were going to + инфинитив: планировал, собирался
• was/were about to + инфинитив: вот-вот собирался (прямо в этот момент)
• would + инфинитив: в рассказе о прошлом, часто после said, knew, thought, promised
• was/were to + инфинитив: по плану, часто в литературном стиле (He was to become a famous writer.)
• was/were + V-ing: запланированное действие (We were meeting at six.)
• was/were going to have done, would have done: о том, что не произошло
usage: 1. Was/were going to — план или намерение в прошлом; иногда план не осуществился. (I was going to call you, but I forgot. = Я собирался тебе позвонить, но забыл. / She said she was going to move to London. = Она сказала, что собирается переехать в Лондон.)

2. Was/were about to — действие вот-вот должно было начаться, когда его что-то прервало. Часто в паре с when. (I was about to leave when the phone rang. = Я уже собирался уходить, когда зазвонил телефон.)
3. Would — предсказание или обещание в рассказе о прошлом, косвенная речь. (He promised he would help. = Он пообещал, что поможет. / I knew it would be difficult. = Я знал, что будет трудно.)
4. Was/were to — судьба или официальный план. (They were to meet again ten years later. = Им предстояло встретиться снова через десять лет.)
5. Was/were V-ing — договорённость. (We were having dinner with them that evening. = В тот вечер мы ужинали с ними.)
signalWords: said that, thought that, knew that, promised, hoped, expected, the next day, the following week, later, when (прервало), just then.
mistakes: ✗ He said he will come. → ✓ He said he would come. После said в прошедшем нужен would.
✗ I was going call her. → ✓ I was going to call her. Пропущено to.
✗ I was about leaving when he arrived. → ✓ I was about to leave when he arrived. После about to идёт инфинитив, а не -ing.
✗ She said she is going to quit. (в рассказе о прошлом) → ✓ She said she was going to quit. Время смещается назад.
✗ I was going to call, but I called. → ✓ I was going to call, but I didn't. Was going to без реализации: потом нужно сказать, что не сделали.
remember: Was going to — «собирался», was about to — «вот-вот собирался», would — «будет» с точки зрения прошлого.

exercises.instruction: Вставьте was/were going to, was/were about to или would

items.prompt: He promised he ___ help us with the deployment.
items.answer: would

items.prompt: I ___ leave the office when my boss called.
items.answer: was about to

items.prompt: We ___ visit Rome, but we changed our plans.
items.answer: were going to

items.prompt: She knew that the project ___ be a success.
items.answer: would

items.prompt: They ___ sign the contract when the lights went out.
items.answer: were about to

items.prompt: I ___ tell you about it, but I forgot.
items.answer: was going to

items.prompt: He said he ___ call me back in an hour.
items.answer: would

items.prompt: We ___ start the meeting when the manager walked in.
items.answer: were about to

items.prompt: She said she (a) will (b) would come to the party.
items.answer: b

items.prompt: I (a) was about to (b) was about call you when you called me.
items.answer: a

items.prompt: He told me he (a) is (b) was going to resign.
items.answer: b

items.prompt: I knew they (a) would be (b) will be late again.
items.answer: a

items.prompt: We were (a) going buy (b) going to buy a new car, but it was too expensive.
items.answer: b

items.prompt: She was (a) about to (b) about leaving the room when he spoke.
items.answer: a

items.prompt: I hoped that things (a) would (b) will get better.
items.answer: a

items.prompt: They said they (a) are meeting (b) were meeting us at six.
items.answer: b

items.prompt: She says, "I will help you." → She said ...
items.answer: She said she would help me. / She said that she would help me.

items.prompt: He thinks, "It's going to be a great day." → He thought ...
items.answer: He thought it was going to be a great day. / He thought that it was going to be a great day.

items.prompt: I am going to call my mother now, but the phone rings. → I was ...
items.answer: I was about to call my mother when the phone rang. / I was going to call my mother when the phone rang.

items.prompt: They say, "We will finish by Friday." → They said ...
items.answer: They said they would finish by Friday. / They said that they would finish by Friday.

items.prompt: I plan to learn Spanish this year. → Last year I ...
items.answer: Last year I was going to learn Spanish.

items.prompt: "The train will be late," she predicted. → She predicted that ...
items.answer: She predicted that the train would be late.

items.prompt: He is just about to press the button, but he stops. → He was ...
items.answer: He was about to press the button, but he stopped.

items.prompt: "We aren't going to win," they believed. → They believed that ...
items.answer: They believed that they weren't going to win. / They believed that they were not going to win. / They believed that they wouldn't win.

items.prompt: He said he will come tomorrow.
items.answer: He said he would come the next day. / He said he would come tomorrow.

items.prompt: I was going call you yesterday.
items.answer: I was going to call you yesterday.

items.prompt: She was about leaving when I arrived.
items.answer: She was about to leave when I arrived.

items.prompt: They told me they are going to move.
items.answer: They told me they were going to move.

items.prompt: I was going to send the email, but I sent it.
items.answer: I was going to send the email, but I didn't.

items.prompt: He promised that he helps me.
items.answer: He promised that he would help me.

items.prompt: We were about to going out when it started to rain.
items.answer: We were about to go out when it started to rain.

items.prompt: I thought it will be easy.
items.answer: I thought it would be easy.

items.prompt: Я собирался позвонить тебе, но забыл.
items.answer: I was going to call you, but I forgot.

items.prompt: Он пообещал, что исправит баг до вечера.
items.answer: He promised he would fix the bug by the evening. / He promised that he would fix the bug by the evening. / He promised he would fix the bug by tonight.

items.prompt: Я уже собирался выйти из дома, когда пошёл дождь.
items.answer: I was about to leave the house when it started to rain. / I was about to leave home when it started to rain.

items.prompt: Мы думали, что поездка будет дорогой.
items.answer: We thought the trip would be expensive. / We thought that the trip would be expensive.

items.prompt: Она сказала, что переедет в Берлин в следующем году.
items.answer: She said she would move to Berlin the following year. / She said that she would move to Berlin the following year. / She said she was going to move to Berlin the next year.

items.prompt: Мы планировали запустить сайт в понедельник.
items.answer: We were going to launch the website on Monday. / We were going to launch the site on Monday. / We were planning to launch the website on Monday.

items.prompt: Я знал, что ты придёшь.
items.answer: I knew you would come. / I knew that you would come.

items.prompt: Он как раз собирался сделать презентацию, когда отключили свет.
items.answer: He was just about to give the presentation when the power went out. / He was about to give the presentation when the power went out. / He was just about to do the presentation when the lights went out.
